card.name: Digits inside years, plus compiler text
card.fires_on: Mainly the digit partway through a four-digit year such as 2009, 1952 or 1929 in general web text. It also fires on a few words in software build and programming-tool instructions.

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: The third or second digit of a year written in numerals, in news or history text.
modes.example: A strong earthquake struck off the Venezuelan coast on September 12, 20<<0>>9.

modes.label: Programming-tool text
modes.description: Small words in instructions about compilers, build options or document tools.
modes.example: you will need to uncheck the<< Enable>> minimal rebuild option in the project

card.writes: It seems to push against compile-related words and to favor miscellaneous word endings, with no clear theme.
card.plain: It lights up on the middle digits of years like 2009 or 1952, and on a few words in software build instructions.
